title: Efficient peroxydisulfate activation by a CoNiFc-MOF for rapid removal of emerging contaminants via both radical and non-radical pathways
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01053A, Paper
Maierhaba Kuerban, Yun Wang, Dilnur Dilxat, Nuzahat Habibul, Yanyun Hu
The synthesized CoNiFc-MOF catalyst can rapidly activate peroxydisulfate (PDS) to efficiently degrade BPA. The synergistic mineralization of BPA into H2O and CO2 through free radical (·O2−) and non-free radical (1O2/e−) pathways.
